Job Buddy handles more application controls reliably and keeps profile edits, theme startup and navigation steadier across the extension and documentation site.

### Added

- Release version and release-notes link in the website header.

### Changed

- Improved keyboard focus, contrast, enlarged-text layouts and feedback across popup, options, guides and demo.
- Refreshed demo recordings and extension screenshots.

### Fixed

- Improved phone, date, degree, salary and React Select fills, including deferred selections.
- Preserved uploaded resumes and kept application dialogs open during Quick Fill.
- Kept tailored narratives and unsupported sensitive questions manual.
- Preserved unsaved profile edits when saved data changes and added recovery for profile-loading errors.
- Prevented white flashes during theme startup and screenshot loading.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/myowinthein/job-buddy/compare/8eb1ef6196bb8d65836a83be77419711320e4428...v2.2.0)
